msg: Don't worry about shape of the gnome. There are red and yellow baskets. The colour of basket that collects the most mushrooms changes through the game. So you will need to swap colour baskets through the game to make sure you are using the one that is collecting the most mushrooms at that time. Each coloured gnome will always have the same coloured basket. So for example Blue gnomes always have a yellow basket, red gnomes always have red etc. So you need to remember which colour gnome has which colour basket. And make sure you press the keys quickly so you don't get timed out.
